# Third-party assets

`unitree_go2/` is an unmodified snapshot of the Unitree Go2 model from
Google DeepMind's MuJoCo Menagerie at commit
`8161bba264d7fa7c99ca301e91e7fb44737676ad`.

The model's own `LICENSE` file is retained inside that directory. Keep the
revision fixed when comparing benchmark reports across Windows and Ubuntu.
